source.title: Telefunken-Zeitung, III. Jahrgang, Nr. 15 (1. Kriegsnummer)
source.publisher: Gesellschaft fuer drahtlose Telegraphie m. b. H. (Telefunken)

visual_checks.finding: A photographed portable radio unit carries the label Tragbares U S Geraet 17. Nearby text describes portable transmitter/receiver sets and trial delivery in May 1918.
The delivery table lists the 400th U-S-Geraet on 28 October 1918. The adjoining discussion concerns equipment using undamped oscillations.

interpretation: US in ZWEIUSGERAETE plausibly denotes contemporary undamped-wave radio apparatus. This is a contextual interpretation of already read letters, not another cipher recovery.
limits: The telegram does not identify a manufacturer or a particular apparatus model.
No missing number, time or location is inferred from this terminology.
The complete journal and its modern digitization are linked, not redistributed.
